Title: Azure Synapse Analytics features availability now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Synapse Analytics is a limitless analytics service that brings together enterprise data warehousing and big data analytics. Now, the new features are available to every user (in preview).

Access the new features and unified experience for accelerated insights, including the Synapse Studio, integrated SQL and Apache Spark engines, serverless data lake exploration, built-in Power BI authoring, and additional capabilities.

Learn more
